description: Turns a tracker ticket into a reviewed, QA-verified pull request: an agent pipeline of eight roles with a gate at every step

interface.longDescription: A tool-neutral agent troika. Every org-specific fact — repos, commands, branches, tracker, URLs — comes from the workspace's own .troika/PROFILE.md profile, so the same procedures run unchanged in any workspace.
